 Other holidays listed in the LAUSD 2026-2027 calendar 
 Which schools are covered by the LAUSD calendar 
 The Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD) confirms in its official calendar to all students that schools at different grade levels will close from November 23 to 27 .
 For this reason, preschool, elementary, and high school students will have -counting the weekends- nine straight days without classes to rest and enjoy one of the most anticipated holidays in the United States.

 The Los Angeles Unified School District is the second-largest in the U.S., with more than 520,000 students enrolled.
 The official calendar says all of these students will have fall break from Nov. 23 to 27 , when public schools in the district suspend classes.
 This break includes Thanksgiving , a federal holiday observed nationwide on Thursday, Nov. 26. As a tradition, families share a dinner centered on the typical turkey.
 Other holidays listed in the LAUSD 2026-2027 calendar
 The official calendar shared by LAUSD includes:
 Jan. 18, 2027: Martin Luther King Jr. Day 
 Feb. 15, 2027: Presidents Day 
 May 31, 2027: Memorial Day 
 June 18, 2027: Juneteenth 
 Which schools are covered by the LAUSD calendar
 According to authorities, the district covers much of the city of Los Angeles and another 25 cities and unincorporated areas , some in part and others entirely.
 It specifies that the public schools in the following cities are part of LAUSD:
 Gardena 
 Huntington Park 
 Lomita 
 Maywood 
 San Fernando 
 Vernon 
 West Hollywood
